scripts.postinstall: node -e "import('./scripts/generate-global-terrestrial-catalog.mjs').then(async g=>{const r=await fetch('https://www.acma.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-07/BroadcastTransmitterExcel.zip',{redirect:'follow',signal:AbortSignal.timeout(20000)});if(!r.ok)throw new Error('ACMA '+r.status);const rows=g.normalizeACMA(Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer()));if(rows.length<150)throw new Error('ACMA count '+rows.length);if(!rows.some(x=>Math.abs(x.frequencyKHz-873)<0.1&&/2GB/i.test((x.callsign||'')+' '+(x.name||''))))throw new Error('ACMA 2GB marker missing');console.log('ACMA normalize ok',rows.length)}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})"
